This position reports directly to the Supervisor of Application Development and is considered entry/intermediate skill level. This position will have a primary responsibility of supporting smaller-scale enhancements of existing web applications or participating in projects for the creation of new web applications while adhering to defined coding standards and practices. The position will be expected to become familiar with the team’s current choice of technology.
